delivery.full_ci: after feature integration; focused checks incremental

B.allowed_use: additive engineering and admitted future qualification

lanes.shim: No automatic legacy-to-NC1 reinterpretation; per-input equality proof and explicit unsupported refusal required

normalization.fit_scope: declared physical FIT row ids only, canonical sorted reductions
normalization.numeric: min-max, unclipped apply, constant zero channel retained
normalization.missing: FIT-derived numeric missing indicator; all-missing zero plus indicator
normalization.nominal: grouped one-hot; always other, missing channel if FIT missing; no target encoding
normalization.kinds_target: explicit declaration; no positional or cardinality task inference
normalization.class_order: declared multiclass labels; binary positive label explicit; no minority inversion
normalization.matrix_dtype: f64; no raw-f64 ULP promise through f32
private: real normalized matrix and row identity payload
normalization.public: structural kind/group/shape metadata only; safe fixed diagnostics

metrics.history: v1/v2 dispatch, fixtures, C02 simultaneous full_family_max_t bounds and aligned identity pins preserved
metrics.s_select: select using synthetic validation only; real test assesses choice/regret
metrics.s_transfer: compare synthetic-trained and real-trained learner ranking on common real test
metrics.uninformative_rank: typed ineligible/null; never perfect agreement or implicit zero
metrics.privacy: empirical diagnostics only; byte counts are not formal memorization or privacy bounds

scientific_parameters.reason: choose on development and freeze in a separately admitted qualification manifest before outcomes

exposure.confirmation: unassigned; cannot be made sealed by renaming
exposure.physical_family_roles: FIT/TUNE/TEST membership and source-to-view identity retained
